Preserve this identity: A distinct massive bald gray-skinned ogre-like demon with a broad flat nose, heavy square jaw, short visible lower tusks, small amber eyes, ONE short curved ivory horn centered on the forehead, and a squat powerlifter build. Thick black iron chains coil over HIS RIGHT shoulder, which appears on the LEFT in a frontal view. A dark sleeveless battered coat and rigid curved IVORY RIB-SHAPED ARMOR frame a glowing red-orange spiritual furnace in the chest. The furnace is supernatural light behind armor, NOT exposed flesh or an anatomical organ. Thin red heat fissures cross his gray skin. TWO arms with normal coherent hands of exactly five fingers each; no extra horns or limbs. Retain the existing one-horn ogre identity, no humanoid beauty face, no crown or wings.
NEW SCENE: Tight PROFILE view of ONLY the ogre on a high ash-covered stone bridge at dusk. A personal HEAT MIRAGE radiating from his armored chest displaces his single coherent gray silhouette a fraction to the side; an anonymous incoming sword passes through the fading HOT-AIR outline and misses the real body. Show ONE actual head and ONE forehead horn, one intact torso, two arms, the right shoulder chain and ivory chest armor. No clone, portal, void, group shield or ally. Red-orange refractive heat, dark sky and simple bridge railing; this is personal invulnerability, not offensive retaliation.
Art direction: striking 2D dark shonen anime, thick expressive black ink contours, bold flat colors, hard-edged cel shadows, graphic motion shapes, very readable at 75px. Distinct crop and camera appropriate to this scene. Clear coherent anatomy and exact target count. No realism, no 3D rendering, no glossy painting, no typography, no text, no UI, no borders, no watermarks. Full bleed square.
